alignment.understanding: A call-site census of every module-level function in both controllers shows nine unreferenced functions, more than the two pairs the user named. Dead in both modules: handle_operation_progress, handle_operation_success, handle_operation_failure, clear_active_operation. Dead in text_chunking only: the _resume_ai_profile_id stub, which ignores both parameters and always returns None. Each dead handler is behaviourally identical to the shared operation_runner_controller private handler that actually runs, so deleting them removes duplication without removing behavior. handle_operation_cancelled must stay in both modules: it is passed as cancel_handler by start_operation and performs manifest sync plus project-state refresh that the runner does not do.
